The '''Imperial Senate Guard''' were elite [[Color/Legends|blue]]-[[Armor/Legends|armor]]ed [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]s within the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guards]] that were loyal to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Taking there role from the disregarded elements of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], these Royal [[Bodyguard/Legends|Guards]] ensured the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] remained loyal to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. The armor of Imperial Senate Guards was a [[Color/Legends|blue]] version of the red and black suits worn by the Royal Guards. A subdivision to this unit was the [[Imperial Senate Sentinel]].

==Overview==
By [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|Guard's]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was a [[Color/Legends|blue]] version of the red and black suits worn by the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]] and [[Emperor's Shadow Guard|Shadow Guard]] respectively.<ref name="TFUvg" /> They were trained solely in melee combat and equipped with [[Cortosis staff/Legends|cortosis staffs]].<ref name="TFUdb" /> The guards also carried [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]] that were powerful enough to deflect [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] attacks.<ref name="TFUvg" />

Outwardly, the Imperial Senate Guard preserved the tradition of their [[Senate Guard/Legends|predecessors]] by serving as protectors of the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] but their true loyalty was to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], however. Other duties of the Guardsmen included the protection of key Imperial installations and high-ranking officials, [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] missions, and the hunt of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].<ref name="TFUdb" />

==History==
[[File:Imperial_senate_guard.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An Imperial Senate Guard attacks Starkiller in Cloud City]]
In 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], several Imperial Senate Guards were attached to a [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] unit of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and Shadow Guardsmen during a [[Skirmish on Cloud City|mission]] to locate the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fugitive [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]. They tracked Kota to a local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], but were subsequently annihilated by [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who required the former [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General's]] expertise on fighting the Empire.<ref name="TFUvg" />

The Imperial Senate Guard [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|encountered]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader's apprentice again on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], where they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] assassin in addition to numerous Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ozzik Sturn]]. Their final [[Battle on Death Star I|confrontation]] with Starkiller took place on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] when the apprentice infiltrated the incomplete [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] to save the founders of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] from his former [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] and the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Several members of both the Senate Guard and Royal Guard rallied to the Emperor's defense on the [[Observation deck/Legends|observation deck]] shortly after Starkiller defeated Vader in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. Despite their failure to defeat him, Starkiller was ultimately slain by Palpatine just as the Rebel leaders escaped on the apprentice's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]''.<ref name="TFUvg" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Senate Guard first appears in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]], [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]], and [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] versions of the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''. They do not feature in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]], and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] versions of the game, and its role is instead given to the [[Imperial Senate Sentinel]].<ref name="TFUvg" />

A [[Unidentified Royal Guard (Death Star II)|similar enemy]] was found in ''[[Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]''.
